title: The operating model is part of the problem
text: The same post describes questions about cross-functional work, central management of agents, deployment, testing and ownership. Buying access leaves those decisions unresolved. It also identifies fragmented information and uneven internal skills as obstacles that a model choice alone does not address.
qualification: The post reports themes rather than disclosing a causal comparison of organisational designs.
